_source: Ministry of Education / Curriculum Development Centre, Zambia. 'Religious Education 2046 Syllabus, Grade 10-12' (2013, published by CDC) — Grade 11, Units 1-7 (Topics 11.1-11.7), Part One: Themes from the Gospels (based on the Gospel of Luke), continued. Cross-referenced against a parallel provincial Religious Education teaching-notes booklet covering the same unit structure, prepared for provincial use with no usage restriction; per standing instruction, no individual name is cited from either source, credit given only to CDC / Ministry of Education. Topic, sub-topic and Specific Outcome statements only; the 'Content' column (Bible passage references, knowledge points, skills, values) is omitted for the reasons documented in the Grade 10 file. As with Grade 10, this document's printed outcome numbering codes are unreliable throughout, so every sub-topic and outcome below was reconstructed by position — matching each outcome to the sub-topic heading it appears directly under in the source table, in the table's own reading order — and given clean sequential numbering rather than reproducing the unreliable printed codes. The syllabus organizes content by Grade only, not by Term in this file (a suggested termly Scheme of Work exists in the syllabus introduction assigning Units to terms), so all of Grade 11 is modeled as a single term here. UPDATE (2026-08-30): term-split and references added, sourced from the same real Ministry-approved Grade 10-12 RE 2046 common scheme of work used for the Grade 10 file (see that file's own UPDATE note for the sourcing/sanitization details — identical source, identical PII stripped). This source gave week RANGES per topic block (e.g. 'weeks 4-7') rather than one exact week per sub-topic — sub-topics were spread evenly across their real stated range rather than assigned a single invented week, and Grade 12's own content (which appears partially merged into this source's Term 3 section, labelled 'GRADE 12 WORK') was deliberately excluded from this file.
